## The mechanism, common to the eight runs
   The boundary this item hands the trace (ring0 above: after `insertOnOutline` and `squareGates`) is simple, touches itself
   nowhere at the attraction distance, holds stage 1's wall (0 points outside, crossesCore false) and meets each culprit
   gate squared to its way (its two neighbours on the line through the gate square to the way, 14.9 m off). The trace then
   pulls (`pullAndPin`, enceinte/pull.ts; §4.4 S5a *Trace* (2)) the gate's neighbours 15 - 30 m inward while the gate stays
   pinned, the smoothing and (32, 81, 188) F-WALL's union-simplify rung keep a V of 12 - 46 deg with its apex at the gate,
   both sides within about 22 deg of the gate's way; the kernel's insertion (insertChain, §3.6 steps 2 - 3: attraction at
   26 cm) then routes both sides through the way's own vertex 55 - 91 cm inward of the gate (the gate's split lies just
   beyond this item's snap distance, 2 x TOUCH_CM = 52 cm): the wall chain takes that vertex twice (degree 3: "branches",
   118, 81) or the gate's knot lands on it (the gate leaves the trace: "trace: gate gate:N is not on the committed trace at
   its point", 32, 188 since M0-c-02 S6). Owner: the enceinte (M0-c-02: trace.ts / pull.ts, the V; the kernel's
   attraction is the stated §3.6 behaviour). REPORTED; nothing of enceinte/ changed.
